aloam.label: A-LOAM
aloam.selection_note: kitti_default was the accuracy candidate in the existing sequence 07 profile comparison (lowest stored 100 m RPE and official RTE there). Its arguments are frozen; the added sequences do not select a profile.

lf_gicp.label: LF-GICP
lf_gicp.selection_note: field beta 0.25 was calibrated on sequence 00 first 500 frames against the paper dilution range, after earlier 02/08 runs exposed excessive gating. Those sequences influenced the decision to recalibrate; no added sequence influences the frozen setting.

definitions.frame_index: Zero-based; a step index is its destination frame (i-1 -> i).
definitions.step_length_ratio: norm(estimated local translation) / norm(GT local translation)
definitions.step_vector_error: norm(estimated local translation - GT local translation) / norm(GT local translation)
definitions.moving_step: GT step >= 0.1 m; shorter steps excluded from relative step counts.
definitions.block_error: Relative pose error between block endpoints, divided by GT path length; diagnostic only, not KITTI RTE.

l_lo.label: L-LO
l_lo.selection_note: cluster_cell=0.25, ground_tolerance=0.15 and max_range=80 were selected by the existing 100 m RPE sweeps on sequence 07 and previously transferred unchanged to 00/02/05/08. Sequence 01 is NA in the paper and excluded.
